[R583] NEGATIVE - exact head db29bdd07529fbc697b7956827092f64b1241714

External independent review, round R583-1, issue #665 / PR #736.
Tree: `8102aa501042b366c2a8abb5a1555fde4eaac2bf`.
Implementation parent: `d40e4e9827be2516f8f34b9d65f0a483fff2194c`.

DA_GATE does not always equal the source owner's declaration predicate. An executable probe reproduces an open gate with an invalid source destination, for both Listener and answered-probe demand. The four-module service-budget table also retains obsolete figures. These findings prevent approval despite passing existing tests and mutation campaigns.

## Scope and reconstruction

Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, issue scope decisions, relevant requirements and interfaces, then the source-base diff and implementation history. The source-base range is `a0f39ad4f4bfc9ed4805bac049c4f2b926a94ec0..db29bdd07529fbc697b7956827092f64b1241714`. The assigned implementation range is only `d40e4e98..db29bdd0`: one commit, 34 changed paths. Inherited #705 work was not reclassified as this lane's change.

Scope: [assignment 6151273346](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/665#issuecomment-6151273346), [correction 6151422598](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/665#issuecomment-6151422598), and [ruling 6092086337 item 4](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/665#issuecomment-6092086337). Authorities examined include REQUIREMENTS.md section 1, mailbox YAML/generated contract, split architecture/publication documentation, processor `docs/architecture/05_acmp_engine.md:405` and `08_timing.md:35`, and pinned stack `docs/PORTING.md:310` and `include/acmp.h:268`.

The independent diff pass preceded public executable evidence. Evidence came from [52d6b147, review-evidence/665f3b-r1](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/52d6b147486ec5561b5862790727b27fb030108a/review-evidence/665f3b-r1). Work-history material was excluded. No private author material or another reviewer's report informed this verdict or ledger. Stack verdict headers and merge metadata were checked for dependency provenance without adopting other reviewers' reasoning.

## Findings

### R583-1-F1 - MAJOR - Conformance, RTL, Robustness, Tests, Docs

**Artifact:** `sw/firmware/ctrl/maap/maap_mbx.c:43` and `:58`; `sw/firmware/ctrl/test/test_maap_mbx.cpp:289`; `sw/mailbox/mailbox.yaml:326`.

**Authority/evidence:** The assignment requires valid DA AND demand. The stack's public contract takes destination validity from `env->source`; `third_party/tsn-c-stack/src/acmp.c:1265` returns `st.dest_mac_valid && (answered || listener_registered)`. The adapter discards that result, reads only demand fields, and substitutes whole-range MAAP validity. The composition expressly retains the integrator's source callback.

`probe_owner.cpp`, built by `run_probes.py` against unchanged candidate firmware and the existing mailbox fixture, acquires a real MAAP range and supplies `dest_mac_valid=false` through the documented source port. After service settles:

```text
R583 MAAP valid=1 source DA valid=0 Listener=1 core predicate=0 DA_GATE=1
R583 answered probe=1 invalid source DA: core predicate=0 DA_GATE=1
```

Both closed-gate assertions fail; restoring source validity passes the positive control. The test exits 1. The driver exits 0 only after reproducing the expected defect. Receipts: `owner-probe.log`, `owner-probe.rc`, `probe_owner.cpp`, `run_probes.py`.

This is a settled-state mismatch, independent of the intended transient before an allocation callback updates its owner. No candidate implementation or tracked test was edited. The existing invalid-destination test covers MAAP invalidity, not invalid per-source DA while the allocated range remains valid.

**Impact:** A source that its ACMP owner considers unable to provide a valid destination can publish an open declaration gate. This also occurs after an accepted destination-failure probe response. The claimed predicate equivalence is false and can expose an incorrect admission level when the split consumer is connected. This is not a claim of a current shipping-image regression.

**Required outcome:** After serialized service, each published source bit must respect authoritative per-source destination validity, interface, allocation and demand. Preserve gate-before-allocation-report ordering and the prohibition on synchronous core calls from MAAP callbacks. Any change to validity ownership must be explicit and coherent.

**Verification:** Add parent composition tests for valid MAAP plus invalid source DA, separately with Listener and answered-probe demand, and a valid-source positive control. Compare the core predicate with the published bit after service at both interface counts. Retain acquisition ordering, expiry, invalid-range, reentry and mutation checks. Re-review the equivalence claim at the corrected head.

### R583-1-F2 - MINOR - Conformance, Tests, Docs

**Artifact:** `docs/design/MAILBOX_SPLIT.md:753` and `:760`, against `sw/firmware/ctrl/app/ctrl_app.h:76` and `maap/maap_mbx.h:19`.

**Authority/evidence:** The page updates the four-module pass cost to 3,523 / 4,429 accesses but leaves the dependent path table and the one-interface 10 ms conclusion unchanged. Independently compiled headers confirm those pass costs (`bounds-if1.log`, `bounds-if2.log`). Applying the page's `(taken-by pass + 1) * pass cost` construction:

| Path | Published IF=1 / IF=2 | Current bound IF=1 / IF=2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Event, pass 2 | 9,981 / 12,639 | 10,569 / 13,287 |
| ACMP input, pass 10 | 36,597 / 46,343 | 38,753 / 48,719 |
| ADP input, pass 21 | 73,194 / 92,686 | 77,506 / 97,438 |
| Owed response, pass 8 | 29,943 / 37,917 | 31,707 / 39,861 |

At the assumed one microsecond per access, the one-interface event envelope is 10.569 ms, exceeding T_svc = 10 ms. Current tests check execution against header bounds but miss the stale published derivation. This is a numerical service/conformance claim, not wording residue. The table partly predates this commit, but the change explicitly revises its inputs and claims updated service bounds.

**Impact:** Understated service envelopes and an incorrect conclusion about the access speed required for T_svc. The separate statement that target timing acceptance remains unmeasured is still valid.

**Required outcome:** Recompute all four rows and access-time thresholds and correct the following 10 ms conclusion. Preserve the distinction between analytical bounds, executed host checks and physical calibration.

**Verification:** Reproduce both header evaluations using `run_probes.py`, verify each multiplication and threshold, and add a focused check tying published figures to those inputs.

### R583-1-R1 - RESIDUE - Docs

**Artifact:** `docs/reference/SUBMODULES.md:256`.

**Evidence:** The new pin and adopted-effects table correctly record ADP #19, but this historical sentence remains: “That `main` also changes `src/adp.c`, which this firmware has not taken.”

**Impact:** Contradictory historical wording. The pin, current behavior table, executable tests, measurements and clause claims need no change for this residue.

**Exact fix / verification:** Delete the sentence and resulting empty paragraph; preserve the correct #19 adoption row. Carry to the manager's residue checklist. This item neither changes the verdict nor makes a lens unclean.

## Independent execution and reviewer-owned ledger

Eight focused arms ran concurrently, at most 12 compile jobs: nine binaries, 562 passing checks (ADP 54; ACMP 128; two-interface ACMP 27; MAAP 37+20; two-interface MAAP 21; SRP composition 58+58; SRP unit 59). The selected 19 plants and five static gates passed. The added predicate probe reproduces F1 with two failing assertions. All build and test copies are disposable.

Reproduction scripts: `run_focused.py --jobs 3`, `run_controls.py --jobs 2`, `run_static.py`, `run_probes.py`, `audit_public.py`, `check_integrity.py`. Each takes `--repo <exact-head checkout> --packet <packet directory>`; `fetch_public.py` takes the packet directory. Individual logs and statuses are retained. No full parent, processor, gPTP, synthesis or builder bank was run.

All five lenses were applied. No lens is banked CLEAN with an attributed finding open. F1 affects architecture even though functional SystemVerilog is unchanged. Passing author evidence is not independent approval.

## Public history, hosted state and real limits

At the public-state capture, PR #736 had two manager review-start comments, no submitted reviews and no inline comments. There were no earlier public findings on this PR to resolve or retain. Historical #704 findings were used only through the scope ruling; the retained two-interface test and removal of the old egress-consequence text were checked directly.

`hosted-summary.json` and `hosted-jobs.json` record exact-head GitHub state, individual steps and observation time. This is observation, not hosted acceptance. The 19:17 UTC snapshot showed successful `firmware-aecp-mutants`, `bdd-conformance`, `changes`, `full-ci-gate`, `docs-check-no-git`, `wire-accountability` and two synthesis shards. Other work was queued/running. `rtl-fast`, `verilator-suites` and `yosys-portability` had not yet produced completed aggregate verdicts; `docs-check` and `elaborate` were still running. The physical job was skipped. Pending or skipped work is not counted as executed success; the JSON snapshot remains the precise status record.

No manager source bank exists at this head and none is inferred. Author source-head evidence is distinct from the manager's future current-dev candidate. The supplied source base/live-dev reference is `a0f39ad4f4bfc9ed4805bac049c4f2b926a94ec0`; the manager must validate the actual current-dev candidate at the merge turn.

Physical calibration: NOT RUN. Field skips and skipped physical CI are not hardware proof. Host bounds do not prove target CPU time, wire timing, RAM fit, timing closure or bench acceptance. The Milan v1.2 predicate was checked against the frozen ruling and pinned processor/stack interfaces; the linked publisher page did not supply the v1.2 clause text in this session. This does not claim independent reading of the complete standards PDF.

The scoped simulator executable reported the assigned 5.050 identity; no new simulation bank was run. No shared install, hardware operation, remote write, commit, push or source fix occurred. Scratch trees are excluded from publication.

`integrity-final.json` compares raw bytes, kinds, executable modes and index entries, all six parent gitlinks and the five required initialized submodules. It records 1,309 parent blobs and 1,043 dependency blobs matching their commit trees, and clean parent status. The unused external gitlink was verified without initializing it.

Manager duties: repair/disposition of F1/F2; corrected-head independent re-review and reviewer acceptance of its ledger; residue R1; hosted/local-replica acceptance; current-dev candidate builder/native validation with public receipts; explicit merge authorization; no review in flight; post-merge containment and issue workflow. This report authorizes none of those actions and does not mark #665 complete.

Only REPORT.md and files named in MANIFEST.sha256 are publishable. Unrelated issue-history captures and every scratch tree are excluded.

R583-1 FINISHED
